title: Blueprint `sk-prop-sf-pf-coherence`: Coherence of the projection formula.
statement:
Let $\Lambda$ be any commutative ring, and let $f:X\to Y$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme] supplied with a chosen factorization $c=(j,p)$, $X\xrightarrow{j}\overline X\xrightarrow{p}Y$, where $j$ is an open immersion [def-weil-open-immersion], $p$ is proper [def-weil-proper-morphism], and $pj=f$. No quasi-compactness of $j$ or Noetherianity is assumed. Work in the ordinary unbounded derived categories $D(T_{\mathrm{et}},\Lambda)$ [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories], with $\otimes=\otimes^L_\Lambda$ [def-kun-derived-tensor]. Write $J=Dj_!$ for degreewise extension by zero [def-weil-pbc-extension-by-zero], $R=Rp_*$ for total derived direct image, and $F=Lf^*$, $P=Lp^*$, $H=Lj^*$ for the constant-coefficient inverse images. Use the adjunction $P\dashv R$ and its projection morphism $\rho_{E,L}:RE\otimes L\to R(E\otimes PL)$ of [def-kun-projection-formula-map], and the canonical open tensor isomorphism $\gamma_{K,V}:JK\otimes V\xrightarrow{\sim}J(K\otimes HV)$ of [lem-pur-etale-open-derived-tensor]. Let $c_L:HP L\xrightarrow{\sim}F L$ be the canonical inverse-image composition comparison of [lem-kun-derived-pullback-composition-monoidal]. Define $T=Rf_!:=RJ$ and its specified projection map by
$$\Pi_{K,L}=R J(1_K\otimes c_L)\circ R(\gamma_{K,PL})\circ\rho_{JK,L}:TK\otimes L\longrightarrow T(K\otimes FL).$$
Let $\alpha_{A,B,C}:(A\otimes B)\otimes C\xrightarrow{\sim}A\otimes(B\otimes C)$ be the canonical derived associator, and let $\delta^f_{L,N}:F(L\otimes N)\xrightarrow{\sim}FL\otimes FN$ be the inverse of the canonical comparison [lem-kun-inverse-image-monoidal]. Then for every $K\in D(X_{\mathrm{et}},\Lambda)$ and $L,N\in D(Y_{\mathrm{et}},\Lambda)$,
$$T(\alpha_{K,FL,FN})\circ\Pi_{K\otimes FL,N}\circ(\Pi_{K,L}\otimes1_N)=T(1_K\otimes\delta^f_{L,N})\circ\Pi_{K,L\otimes N}\circ\alpha_{TK,L,N}.$$
Both sides have source $(TK\otimes L)\otimes N$ and target $T(K\otimes(FL\otimes FN))$. In particular this holds for the chosen compactification used to define the upstream canonical $Rf_!$ and projection map. No invertibility of $\Pi$, finiteness of $\Lambda$, boundedness, constructibility or finite Tor-amplitude of the complexes is assumed.
